service_contract.notes: Read-only family service. Update/write ownership remains downstream.

MASTER_MODEL.purpose: Canonical reporting model containing WBS, progress, engineering history and procurement lifecycle data.

EXECUTION_REPORT.purpose: Human-facing weekly report page combining progress, delay narratives and engineering exception lists.

PROCUREMENT_REPORT.purpose: Human-facing equipment/procurement status page linked to the master model.

ownership_classes.PROTECTED: Must not be overwritten by Cleaner or downstream writers unless explicitly approved.
ownership_classes.MAPPER_INPUT: May receive mapped schedule/progress data after reviewed WBS matching.
ownership_classes.REFERENCE: Reference/key field used for validation and mapping.
ownership_classes.WEEKLY_INPUT: Deliberate weekly input such as report/status date.
